name: Otomeza Viruru
source:
Neurotic and clear-headed, as well as a “good guy”, he’s the Prince of Virgo.

He loves to analyze and define things. He is too fastidious and that can irritate those around him. He is a perfectionist, but his attentive and anxious nature leads him to bottle things up. He appears confident, but is actually quite shy.
